` L413: ## Accessibility L414: * Colour alone must not say that a field is wrong. Keep `aria-invalid="true"` on the field and a message in text. L415: * Give the feedback element an `id` and point the field at it with `aria-describedby`, so the message is read with the field rather than after the form. L416: * Say what to do, not only what failed. "Please provide a valid city" beats "Invalid". L417: * On submit, move focus to the first field that failed. Otherwise a keyboard user has to hunt for it. L418: * Validate when the user leaves a field, not on every keystroke. A message that appears and disappears while typing is announced over and over.
